features.title: Answer ctx.web fetches across redirects with the readable article
features.summary: A fetch backend for the web seam: follows cross-origin redirects with public-address revalidation and pinning on every hop, decodes JavaScript, YAML, TOML and sniffed untyped text, and reduces HTML to its Mozilla Readability article.
failureModes: A redirect to a non-public, non-HTTP or credentialed URL fails with WEB_BLOCKED_URL or WEB_INVALID_URL before it is requested.
More redirects than maxRedirects fail with WEB_REDIRECT_BLOCKED and name the setting.
A binary body fails with WEB_UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT_TYPE and points at bash curl -o.
A caller abort is WEB_ABORTED; the whole-fetch deadline is WEB_FETCH_TIMEOUT.

externalDependencies.boundary: Anonymous GET of the requested URL and each redirect target, through the process proxy when one applies.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/provider.test.ts replaces the transport with a host table and runs the real address validation over its answers.

verification.testName: follows a cross-origin redirect and resolves and pins every hop afresh
refuses a redirect whose target resolves to a private address
refuses a redirect to a loopback literal, a non-HTTP scheme or embedded credentials
stops at the hop cap with a recovery hint
decodes JavaScript, YAML and untyped UTF-8 text
refuses binary bodies and says how to get them
returns the article without navigation or footer, with links made absolute
registers the readable fetch provider for the plugin lifetime and validates URLs with the current settings

telemetry.testName: records a web fetch span with hop counts and the extraction outcome, never the URL or body

features.title: Source chips under web_search and web_fetch results
features.summary: Each web_search and web_fetch row in the transcript keeps the native view and gains one chip per page it returned, under the card through tool-meta's tool.call.sections seat: the host and the page title (web_search's source titles, web_fetch's article heading), the URL in a tooltip. A click opens the page in the browser pane beside the thread when one takes it, otherwise in a new tab; a modified or middle click always opens a new tab.

configuration.constraints: Boolean; off renders no chips and the native web rows unchanged.

failureModes: A failed result, a call that has not settled, or meta without sources shows no chips.
A non-HTTP(S) or malformed URL never becomes a chip; a repeated URL shows once.
Without tool-meta's tool-call frame composed the seat is absent, so the web rows keep only their native view.

externalDependencies.boundary: The chips render under the tool card through the @dshfiles/tool-meta/tool-call-sections registry that tool-meta's frame fills; web-fetch-readable depends on tool-meta, never the reverse.
externalDependencies.deterministicFake: tests/citation-sources.test.ts covers the sources the section shows; the section component itself renders in the citations journey.

verification.testName: reads web_search sources in order, keeps titles, drops non-web URLs and repeats
titles a web_fetch page by its article heading and names the final URL
answers only a settled, successful web call, and no other tool

telemetry.reason: Client-only: the chips read the tool result's replayable meta; opening a page is a browser navigation.

ioDelegation.reason: ReadableFetchProvider.fetch opens the web fetch span around every resolution and request this transport makes.
